question: What initial practice involving the root wheel begins the described yogic process?
premises: The practice begins with the first stage
The root wheel is the object of practice
The beloved is addressed at this starting point
inference: The process begins when one first practices with the root wheel.
uncertainties: mūlacakrantu and yadānyabhyasate are fused forms; boundaries are interpretive
plain_english: O Beloved, first, when one practices the root wheel.
